items.title: Learn T-SQL With Erik: Aligning Queries and Indexes Part 3
items.author: Erik Darling (Erik Darling Data)
items.summary:
In this video, I delve into an engaging demonstration that showcases how query tuning and index design can significantly impact SQL Server performance. Erik Darling from Darling Data walks you through a series of practical examples using T-SQL to optimize queries and indexes. You'll learn about the nuances of parameter sniffing and how different execution plans are generated based on input parameters, especially when dealing with uncommon or common values. The demo highlights the importance of separating informational columns from relational ones in your query design, demonstrating a clever self-join technique that can lead to more efficient execution plans. By the end of this video, you'll gain valuable insights into how to better align your queries and indexes for optimal performance.

CHAPTERS

00:00:00 - Introduction
00:02:15 - Index Alignment and Design
00:04:33 - Query Tuning Magic
00:06:54 - Parameter Sniffing Issue
00:09:40 - Execution Plan Variations
00:11:55 - Relational Columns and Aliases
00:14:28 - Optimizing Queries
00:17:14 - Memory Grants and Indexes
